Hey Product Hunt 👋

We built OpenShip because deploying still feels like a stack of tools: a PaaS for git deploys, a panel for servers, scripts for rollbacks, and a lock-in problem if you ever want to move.

OpenShip is an open source platform for deploying apps on infrastructure you own or on OpenShip Cloud if you don’t want to run servers. [...] Self host is free and Apache-2.0. Cloud starts at $5/mo.

If you’ve been stuck between “easy but locked in” and “owned but painful,” this is the version we wanted.  
  
Try today: www.openship.io

Ahliman HUSEYNOV

Waiting for community Plugins & Themes to use it but I will always support this project! [...] Push from Git, the CLI, the desktop app, or an AI agent over MCP. It detects the stack, builds an immutable version on your machine, ships it over SSH, and brings the new version live with zero downtime. No agent installed on the server. One click rolls back to any previous version.

Same workflow everywhere:

•⁠ ⁠OpenShip Cloud when you want managed deploys

•⁠ ⁠Your own VPS, bare metal, or homelab when you want ownership

•⁠ ⁠Hybrid when you want both

•⁠ ⁠Move either direction later without rebuilding

Also included: preview URLs for PRs, custom domains + auto SSL, scaling across servers, live logs, and a topology view of what’s actually running.

Self host is free and Apache-2.0. Cloud starts at $5/mo.
